item.description:

Issued at: 10:00 PM, 02 November 2026

All are advised to continue monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 11 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 11 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 3:30 AM, 02 November 2026(Monday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bulacan (Dona Remedios Trinidad, San Miguel, and San Ildefonso), Laguna (Siniloan, Santa Maria, Famy, Mabitac, and Pangil), Nueva Ecija (Pantabangan, Rizal, Laur, Gabaldon, Bongabon, Palayan, General Tinio, Gapan, Penaranda, and San Leonardo), Quezon (General Nakar, Real, Infanta, Burdeos, Panukulan, Polillo, and Patnanungan), and Rizal (Tanay and Pililla) within the next 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
